shellCommands.command: ls -a; cat package.json; ls src app 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'middleware.*' -o -maxdepth 3 -name 'proxy.*' -not -path './node_modules/*' | grep -v node_modules; git status --short

node -p "require('next/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "proxy.ts" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -5; cat next.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "localhost:3123/?x=1"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/nope; sleep 2; cat /tmp/dev.log; pkill -f "next dev"
